628:t_1:90.en: ～$$ラース・バビロン$$ Imperial Palace - Forecourt～

628:t_1:91.en:
$$沙慈$$
「$$刹那$$! And $$バナージ$$ too!」

628:t_1:93.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Just so you know, $$ミコット$$ and I are here too.」

628:t_1:94.en:
$$ルイス$$
「I'm sorry. But I never imagined we'd meet in a place like this.」

628:t_1:95.en:
$$刹那$$
「Neither did I, $$ルイス・ハレヴィ$$.」

628:t_1:96.en:
$$ルイス$$
「I'm happy, $$刹那$$. There were so many things I wanted to talk to you about.」

628:t_1:97.en:
$$刹那$$
「I wanted to talk to you too.」

628:t_1:98.en:
$$ルイス$$
「Hehe... When we first met, we didn't get along, and we even fought each other in mobile suits.」

628:t_1:99.en:
$$刹那$$
「But now we can be happy to see each other again like this. People can change.」

628:t_1:100.en:
$$ルイス$$
「Yes. Seeing you smile makes me really feel that.」

628:t_1:102.en:
$$ミコット$$
「I also have a message from $$カレン$$ and $$スザク$$. They want to spend some time with you once things settle down.」

628:t_1:103.en:
$$ルイス$$
「Tell them I'd love to... I want to see them both too.」

628:t_1:105.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「I'm just glad you're both safe.」

628:t_1:106.en:
$$ルイス$$
「It's because $$沙慈$$... kept protecting me all this time.」

628:t_1:108.en:
$$沙慈$$
「Tell me, $$刹那$$. What happened between the time we parted and today?」

628:t_1:109.en:
$$刹那$$
「A lot happened... But I'm still alive, just as you see.」

628:t_1:110.en:
$$沙慈$$
「It seems you've gotten even stronger, $$刹那$$.」

628:t_1:114.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$リボンズ・アルマーク$$!」

628:t_1:120.en:
$$刹那$$
「This sensation...! Is it the $$脳量子波$$ he's emitting!?」

628:t_1:121.en:
$$バナージ$$
「So those are what's hurting $$ルイス$$!」

628:t_1:123.en:
$$刹那$$
「Are you an $$イノベイド$$ of the same type as $$リボンズ・アルマーク$$?」

628:t_1:125.en:
$$刹那$$
「Answer me! If you don't, I'll shoot!」

628:t_1:129.en:
$$ミコット$$
「No way...! The bullets aren't hurting him!」

628:t_1:130.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「This guy...! Is he not human!?」

628:t_1:132.en:
$$刹那$$
「If he doesn't even bleed, he's not an $$イノベイド$$ either...! Then...!」

628:t_1:134.en:
$$刹那$$
「Either my bullets run out first, or this thing goes down!」

628:t_1:140.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「What the hell is this thing...?」

628:t_1:143.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Metal that emits $$脳量子波$$... Could this be...」

628:t_1:145.en:
$n
「$$刹那$$, $$バナージ$$! Get everyone here back inside the Imperial Palace immediately!」

628:t_1:147.en:
$n
「It's the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$...! They're mimicking humans and attacking people with $$脳量子波$$ or $$精神感応波$$!」

628:t_1:148.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「I can't believe they've come down to Earth...!」

628:t_1:149.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ about to begin a full-scale invasion...?」

628:t_1:154.en: ～$$地球連邦軍$$ - $$ブレインズ$$ Research Facility～

628:t_1:156.en:
$$ロイド$$
「So this cutie is that high school girl Dr. $$トライア$$ sent over.」

628:t_1:157.en:
$$セシル$$
「Her name is $$アーミア・リー$$. Until a few days ago, she was held captive for use in $$ラース・バビロン$$'s $$霊子吸収システム$$, but...」

628:t_1:158.en:
$$セシル$$
「After she was freed, an $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ mimicking a human assimilated half her body.」

628:t_1:159.en:
$$ビリー$$
「We knew from $c's report that the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ are drawn to $$脳量子波$$, but to think they'd even assimilate human bodies...」

628:t_1:160.en:
$$ラクシャータ$$
「Since they're drawn to $$脳量子波$$, when you get down to it, human bodies are probably exactly what they want to assimilate.」

628:t_1:162.en:
$$セシル$$
「Humans who emit $$精神感応波$$, such as $$イノベイター$$s and $$ニュータイプ$$s... The so-called humanity of a new era.」

628:t_1:163.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「Could this be connected to $$サイデリアル$$ monitoring human evolution...?」

628:t_1:164.en:
$$ロイド$$
「Who knows... But this puts us in a bind.」

628:t_1:165.en:
$$セシル$$
「Our investigation showed that both $$アースノイド$$s and $$スペースノイド$$s were being held captive in that $$霊子吸収システム$$.」

628:t_1:166.en:
$$セシル$$
「In other words, until now, that facility was protecting most of the humans in the Earth Sphere who emit $$脳量子波$$.」

628:t_1:167.en:
$$ラクシャータ$$
「We don't know if it was a coincidence, but the result was that it delayed the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ invasion of Earth.」

628:t_1:169.en:
$$ビリー$$
「We believe the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ transmit information through $$脳量子波$$...」

628:t_1:170.en:
$$ビリー$$
「The huge $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ force at the edge of the Earth Sphere probably learned from its advance party on Earth that many humans emit $$脳量子波$$.」

628:t_1:171.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「The $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ will come to Earth soon...」
